<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/appointments"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Books a door window (`windowStart` inclusive, `windowEnd` exclusive,
`windowEnd > windowStart`, at most 4 hours, not starting in the past)
for a carrier, covering one or more registered ASNs. Two appointments
in `Booked` or `CheckedIn` may not overlap on one door: 409
`door-window-overlap`. A covered ASN that does not exist is 422
`unknown-asn`; one that is `Closed` or `Cancelled` is 409
`asn-not-receivable`. When `DOCK_DOOR_MODE=kafka` a door that is not an
inbound dock is 422 `unknown-dock-door`. Publishes
`DockAppointmentBooked`.
